shortDescription: Updates the advanced threat configuration settings

options.name: active_x_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether sites are allowed or blocked from accessing vulnerable ActiveX controls that are known to have been exploited.

options.name: active_x_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for ActiveX controls

options.name: ad_spyware_sites_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether to allow or block websites known to contain adware or spyware that displays malicious advertisements that can collect users' information without their knowledge

options.name: ad_spyware_sites_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for adware and spyware sites

options.name: alert_for_unknown_or_suspicious_c2_traffic
options.displayName: Alert For Unknown Or Suspicious C2 Traffic
options.description: Indicates whether to send alerts upon detecting unknown or suspicious C2 traffic

options.name: anonymizer_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether to allow or block applications and methods used to obscure the destination and the content accessed by the user, therefore blocking traffic to anonymizing web proxies.

options.name: anonymizer_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for anonymizers

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: bit_torrent_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether to allow or block the usage of BitTorrent, a popular P2P file sharing application that supports content download with encryption.

options.name: bit_torrent_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for BitTorrent

options.name: block_countries_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for blocked countries

options.name: blocked_countries
options.description: Whether to allow or block requests to websites located in specific countries. Provide a ISO3166 Alpha2 code. Visit the following site for reference U(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_3166_country_codes)

options.name: browser_exploits_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether known web browser vulnerabilities prone to exploitation are allowed or blocked.

options.name: browser_exploits_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for browser exploits

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: cmd_ctl_server_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether connections to known Command & Control (C2) Servers are allowed or blocked

options.name: cmd_ctl_server_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for connections to known C2 servers

options.name: cmd_ctl_traffic_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether botnets are allowed or blocked from sending or receiving commands to unknown servers

options.name: cmd_ctl_traffic_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for botnets

options.name: cookie_stealing_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether to allow or block third-party websites that gather cookie information which can be used to personally identify users, track internet activity, or steal a user's session or sensitive information.

options.name: cookie_stealing_pcap_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for cookie stealing

options.name: crypto_mining_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether to allow or block cryptocurrency mining network traffic and scripts Which can negatively impact endpoint device performance and potentially lead to a misuse of company resources.

options.name: crypto_mining_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for cryptomining

options.name: dga_domains_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether to allow or block domains that are suspected to be generated using domain generation algorithms (DGA)

options.name: dga_domains_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for DGA domains

options.name: file_format_vunerabilites_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether known file format vulnerabilities and suspicious or malicious content in Microsoft Office or PDF documents are allowed or blocked

options.name: file_format_vunerabilites_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for file format vulnerabilities

options.name: google_talk_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether to allow or block access to Google Hangouts, a popular P2P VoIP application.

options.name: google_talk_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for Google

options.name: irc_tunnelling_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether to allow or block IRC traffic being tunneled over HTTP and HTTPS

options.name: irc_tunnelling_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for IRC tunnels

options.name: known_phishing_sites_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether known phishing sites are allowed or blocked

options.name: known_phishing_sites_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for known phishing sites

options.name: malicious_urls_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for malicious URLs

options.name: malware_sites_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether known malicious sites and content are allowed or blocked

options.name: malware_sites_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for malicious sites

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: potential_malicious_requests_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether to allow or block this type of cross-site scripting (XSS)

options.name: potential_malicious_requests_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for (XSS) attacks

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: risk_tolerance
options.description: The Page Risk tolerance index set between 0 and 100 (100 being the highest risk). Users are blocked from accessing web pages with higher Page Risk than the specified value.

options.name: risk_tolerance_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for suspicious web pages

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: ssh_tunnelling_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether to allow or block SSH traffic being tunneled over HTTP and HTTPS

options.name: ssh_tunnelling_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for SSH tunnels

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: suspect_adware_spyware_sites_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether to allow or block any detections of communication and callback traffic associated with spyware agents and data transmission

options.name: suspect_adware_spyware_sites_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for suspected adware and spyware sites

options.name: suspected_phishing_sites_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether to allow or block suspected phishing sites identified through heuristic detection. The Zscaler service can inspect the content of a website for indications that it might be a phishing site.

options.name: suspected_phishing_sites_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for suspected phishing sites

options.name: tor_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether to allow or block the usage of Tor, a popular P2P anonymizer protocol with support for encryption.

options.name: tor_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for Tor

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.

options.name: webspam_blocked
options.description: Indicates whether to allow or block web pages that pretend to contain useful information, To get higher ranking in search engine results or drive traffic to phishing, adware, or spyware distribution sites.

options.name: webspam_capture
options.description: Indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not for web spam
